learning_objective: 🎯 Discover the amazing families of musical instruments and learn how they create magical sounds through plucking, striking, or blowing!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: String instruments make sound when you pluck, bow, or strum their tight strings. The thicker the string, the deeper and lower the musical note it plays!
Wind instruments require your breath to come alive. By blowing air into them and covering tiny holes with your fingers, you can easily change the pitch of the music.
Percussion instruments keep the heartbeat of the music alive. You play them by shaking, tapping, or striking them with your hands or special wooden sticks.

fun_activity.title: 🎸 Homemade Rock Star Guitar
fun_activity.instructions: Stretch different sizes of rubber bands over an empty tissue box. Pluck them gently to hear how the thin rubber bands make higher sounds than the thick ones!

quick_recap: ⭐ Musical instruments are grouped into families like strings, winds, and percussion based on how they make sound.
⭐ All instruments create music by making invisible sound waves called vibrations.
⭐ The shape and material of an instrument completely change the way its music sounds to our ears.
